name: Teleport Sigil
description: A dormant circle of pathways beneath the campus, waiting for a key it did not choose.

tiers.description: Parties may also step to the guild's own outposts, secured sites, claimed shard zones and held supply caches. The circle can be opened from the far side too: a kingdom hostile to the guild can learn its pattern and strike the campus through it.
A detachment can be recalled to its party from anywhere, and a marching party can abandon the road and step home to the dock.

A doctrine, chartered at the Grand Hall. The Gate Network: every settlement of an Allied kingdom is a waystone. Or the Sally Port: the wizard steps through the circle to a field party for the reagent alone, no days lost.

doctrines.name: The Gate Network
doctrines.description: Every town and city of an Allied kingdom becomes a waystone your parties can step to. Allies shrink the map.

doctrines.name: The Sally Port
doctrines.description: The Warlord's building. Summoning the wizard to a field party's dive costs only the reagent (5 splinters): the days the summons would add to the dive are spared, so the wizard can go to war whenever a party needs them.
